title: lingamr (development version)
text: VARMA coefficients estimated deterministic two-stage Hannan-Rissanen procedure instead statsmodels’ state-space maximum likelihood (VARMAX), max_iter parameter counterpart; unpruned MA causal matrices use full similarity transform omega = (- B0) Theta (- B0)^{-1} (Python implementation drops trailing inverse factor three-argument np.dot call); residual filtering initializes first max(p, q) residuals zeros instead standard-normal draws, making fit deterministic; lagged designs used pruning total-effect estimation restricted rows every regressor observed instead wrapping rows around (np.roll), total-effect design fills extra from_lag blocks Python implementation allocates leaves zero. causal discovery nonlinear additive models unobserved variables. result new CAMUVResult class: adjacency matrix holds 0/1 edge indicators (coefficients estimated), variable pairs suspected connected unobserved causal backdoor path NA, matching print() / tidy() / glance() / autoplot() methods. regressor pluggable lingam_resit() (Python implementation hardcodes pygam’s LinearGAM; default mgcv’s gam()). Prior knowledge uses upstream pair format (c(, j) = “variable cause variable j”, 1-based). independence = "fcorr" restricted num_explanatory_vals = 2, Python implementation silently breaks larger subsets. bootstrap variant, matching Python implementation. Added lingam_resit(), lingam_resit_bootstrap(), generate_resit_sample(), R port RESIT (Regression Subsequent Independence Test; Peters et al. 2014) causal discovery nonlinear additive noise models. regressor pluggable: default "gam" fits smoothing-spline GAMs via suggested package mgcv, function function(X, y) returning fitted values can supplied instead. result new ResitResult class whose adjacency matrix holds 0/1 edge indicators (RESIT estimates coefficients), matching print() / tidy() / glance() / autoplot() methods. Unlike Python implementation, bootstrap stores -zero total-effects array (total_effects NULL); total effects undefined nonlinear models. hsic_test_gamma() (internal) now accepts matrix arguments, combining columns single multivariate Gaussian kernel Python implementation; univariate callers unchanged (bit-identical results). Fixed setup_cluster_worker() (internal, shared *_bootstrap() functions) fall back exporting development namespace installed copy package stale, instead silently mixing old new code workers. lingam_lim() gains is_poisson argument Poisson-type count discrete variables. is_poisson = TRUE, discrete columns (is_continuous = FALSE) validated non-negative integer counts local search phase scores Poisson regression log-likelihoods (unregularized multivariate glm(family = poisson()) intercept; closed-form intercept-Poisson MLE parentless variables). intent-faithful port Python implementation’s fit(is_poisson=True): global optimization phase keeps logistic surrogate loss, several upstream scoring bugs deliberately reproduced (see Details section ?lingam_lim). generate_lim_sample() gains matching is_poisson argument, LiMResult objects now carry is_poisson field. Restructured vignettes: vignette("lingamr") (Japanese translation) now short introduction covering core idea minimal end--end workflow, method-selection guidance split new vignette("method-selection"). -depth, per-method walkthroughs (prior knowledge, regression backends, bootstrap diagnostics, time series, latent confounders, nonlinear methods, special data types) moved pkgdown-articles package website, English Japanese.

text: Extended broom tidiers autoplot() new result classes: tidy() methods LiMResult, ParceLingamResult RCDResult (keeping NA adjacency entries visible estimate = NA rows), MultiGroupLingamResult MultiGroupBootstrapResult (stacked group column), ImputationBootstrapResult (collapsed via as_bootstrap_result()); glance() methods LiMResult (n_discrete), ParceLingamResult (n_na_entries), RCDResult (n_confounded_pairs), MultiGroupLingamResult (n_groups); autoplot() methods LiMResult, ParceLingamResult, RCDResult (suspected latent-confounder / unresolved pairs drawn dashed segments), MultiGroupLingamResult (one group time via group argument). Added lingam_rcd(), lingam_rcd_bootstrap(), generate_rcd_sample(), R port RCD (Repetitive Causal Discovery; Maeda Shimizu 2020) causal discovery robust latent confounders. Unlike lingam_parce(), RCD recover causal order; instead repeatedly extracts variable’s ancestor set (ancestors_list), narrows ancestor sets direct parents, tests remaining parent-free pairs shared latent confounder, marking corresponding adjacency-matrix entries NA. estimate_total_effect_rcd() get_error_independence_p_values_rcd() RCDResult counterparts estimate_total_effect() get_error_independence_p_values(). Reuses HSIC F-correlation independence measures added lingam_parce(), adds optional MLHSICR regression mode (HSIC-sum minimization via stats::optim(method = "L-BFGS-B")) fallback OLS residuals independent explanatory variables. Added bootstrap_with_imputation(), R port Python lingam.tools.bootstrap_with_imputation(), causal discovery data containing missing values. bootstrap resample (drawn replacement, missing values retained) multiply imputed n_repeats complete datasets (default via mice::mice(method = "norm"), new Suggests dependency), common causal structure shared imputed datasets jointly estimated lingam_multi_group(). Imputation causal-discovery estimation can swapped custom implementations via imputer cd_fit arguments; return values validated descriptive errors violation. result ImputationBootstrapResult, whose extra n_repeats dimension can collapsed regular BootstrapResult new as_bootstrap_result() helper reuse existing bootstrap analysis functions (get_probabilities(), get_causal_direction_counts(), etc.). Added evaluate_model_fit(), R port Python lingam.utils.evaluate_model_fit(). Fits causal graph implied estimated adjacency matrix (lingamr result object LingamResult / ParceLingamResult / LiMResult) structural equation model via lavaan::sem() (new Suggests dependency) returns standard SEM fit measures (CFI, RMSEA, AIC/BIC, etc.). NA entries marking latent confounder pair represented residual covariance lavaan model, equivalent latent-variable representation used Python semopy-based original. Added lingam_parce(), lingam_parce_bootstrap(), generate_parce_sample(), R port BottomUpParceLiNGAM (Tashiro et al. 2014) causal discovery robust latent confounders. algorithm searches causal order sink side stops independence test rejected; variables order returned single unresolved block, corresponding adjacency-matrix entries NA. estimate_total_effect_parce() get_error_independence_p_values_parce() ParceLingamResult counterparts estimate_total_effect() get_error_independence_p_values(). Adds two new internal-independence measures reusable future ports: HSIC gamma-approximation test (R/hsic.r) F-correlation / kernel canonical correlation (R/f_correlation.r). Added lingam_multi_group(), lingam_multi_group_bootstrap(), get_group_result(), generate_multi_group_sample(), R port MultiGroupDirectLiNGAM (Shimizu 2012) jointly estimating Direct LiNGAM model across multiple datasets (“groups”) share common causal order may different structural coefficients. Per-group analysis (total causal effects, independence tests, plotting) reuses existing single-group functions via get_group_result(), extracts group plain LingamResult. Added lingam_high_dim(), R port HighDimDirectLiNGAM (Wang & Drton 2020) causal discovery high-dimensional data (large p, p > n). Causal order search uses moment statistics non-Gaussianity instead pairwise independence measures, deterministic. Added lingam_lim() generate_lim_sample(), R port LiM (LiNGAM Mixed data) algorithm (Zeng et al. 2022) causal discovery data containing mixture continuous binary (0/1) discrete variables. Fixed condition kernel-based independence measure (measure = "kernel") made soft prior knowledge silently ineffective. Fixed reg_method = "ridge" erroring inside lingam_direct_bootstrap() estimate_total_effect() / estimate_all_total_effects(). Fixed lambda = "oracle" rejected upfront reg_method = "lasso" ("ridge" previously validated), previously surfaced unclear glmnet error. Fixed data-scale dependence default adaptive-LASSO regularization path (fit_regression.r): AIC/BIC lambda search grid now scaled response’s magnitude instead using fixed absolute grid. select_var_lag() now guards selecting overfit, near-saturated lag order sample size small relative number variables candidate lags. lingam_direct_bootstrap() longer aborts entirely single bootstrap iteration fails (e.g. degenerate resample); failing iteration now skipped warning, results reflect however many iterations succeeded. Added compute_total_effects argument lingam_direct_bootstrap() skip (comparatively expensive) total-effects estimation step edge/order stability needed. get_causal_direction_counts() now vectorized substantially faster large bootstrap results. get_error_independence_p_values(method = "kendall") now warns large n, Kendall’s tau O(n^2) per variable pair. kernel-based independence measure (measure = "kernel") now switches incomplete-Cholesky low-rank approximation n > 1000, cutting per-pair cost O(n^3) O(n*d^2) (~200x faster n = 5000); n <= 1000 still uses exact computation. Removed unconditional Suggests-package dependencies examples, added \examples remaining exported print.* methods. Expanded test coverage (previously untested BootstrapResult query functions, numerical validation total-effect estimates, additional input-validation tests).

title: lingamr 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. Direct LiNGAM (lingam_direct()) selectable regression backends adjacency-matrix estimation via reg_method: ordinary least squares ("ols"), LASSO ("lasso"), adaptive LASSO ("adaptive_lasso"), ridge regression ("ridge"). lingam_direct_bootstrap() provides bootstrap stability assessment, including causal-order stability, supports multi-core execution parallel n_cores arguments (via parallel::makePSOCKcluster()). Sequential execution remains default. Parallel runs use L’Ecuyer parallel RNG streams, results reproducible given seed/n_cores differ numerically sequential path. Model diagnostics: residual independence normality tests, plus one-call summary_lingam(). Visualization DiagrammeR (interactive) ggplot2 autoplot() (static). broom-style tidiers (tidy() / glance()).
